# svysem

Design-based structural equation models for complex survey data. The
model is fitted with [lavaan](https://lavaan.ugent.be/). Sampling
weights, clustering and stratification come from a
[survey](https://cran.r-project.org/package=survey) design, the
procedure of Mplus `TYPE = COMPLEX`.

Continuous outcomes use MLM (Satorra-Bentler) or MLR (Yuan-Bentler),
including `missing = "ml"`. A model with `group=` uses replicate weights
for MLM, so a between-group contrast keeps the covariance from primary
sampling units that contain both groups. Ordered indicators use WLSMV,
with replicate-weight standard errors.
[`predict()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/predict.html) returns factor
scores for continuous outcomes. A `svyrep.design` is accepted.

Completed data sets from a multiple imputation are fitted one by one and
pooled with Rubin’s rules. The design degrees of freedom are the
complete-data degrees of freedom.

The method for a single design follows Oberski (2014,
<doi:10.18637/jss.v057.i01>). No code is taken from lavaan.survey.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`pooled_estimates()`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/pooled_estimates.md)
  : Pooled parameter estimates
- [`pooled_wald()`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/pooled_wald.md)
  : Wald test of pooled constraints
- [`predict(`*`<svysem>`*`)`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/predict.svysem.md)
  [`predict(`*`<svysem_mi>`*`)`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/predict.svysem.md)
  : Factor scores and plausible values
- [`coef(`*`<svysem>`*`)`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/svysem-class.md)
  [`vcov(`*`<svysem>`*`)`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/svysem-class.md)
  [`show(`*`<svysem>`*`)`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/svysem-class.md)
  [`summary(`*`<svysem>`*`)`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/svysem-class.md)
  [`print(`*`<svysem.summary>`*`)`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/svysem-class.md)
  : Design-based SEM fit
- [`svysem()`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/svysem.md)
  [`svycfa()`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/svysem.md)
  [`svygrowth()`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/svysem.md)
  : Design-based structural equation models.
- [`svysem(`*`<svyimputationList>`*`)`](https://siyangni.github.io/svysem/reference/svysem.svyimputationList.md)
